headline: Fastest in program history at Woodward Park
body: The girls ran the fastest team time in Monte Vista history on the Woodward Park course on Saturday, finishing sixth overall and first among Division 2 schools. Kaylie O'Connell, Nadya Makarova and Ava Padilla ran 17:33, 17:40 and 18:04 respectively. Those three runners now rank second, third and fifth in school history at Woodward Park.

headline: All 31 Mustangs improved at Mid-Season Mania, led by freshman Arthur Tochilnik in 10:10.7.
body: All 31 athletes who ran both 3200m time trials went faster than they did in August. Arthur Tochilnik broke Monte Vista's freshman record in the 3200m, running 10:10.7 and finishing as the top freshman in the field.
